description: Ari Akademisi ekibi olarak arı bilimi üzerine çalışıyoruz. Bu meydan okumada Dogayi ve tarimi NASA verileriyle bulusturacak, geliştirecek bir uygulama tasarliyoruz. Proje liderligi, veri analizi ve sunum surecimiz ortaokul ekibimizle hazir. Uygulamamizin arayuz tasarimini yapacak (UI/UX) ve projeyi prototipe donusturecek (Yazilimci) takim arkadaslari ariyoruz. NASA verilerini pratik bir uygulamaya donusturmek isteyen yetenekli arkadaslari ekibimize bekliyoruz
summary:
Shifting planting calendars and changing weather patterns are rapidly shortening agricultural growing seasons, leading to severe drops in crop yield and threatening global food security. To address the Field Shift challenge, we developed BEEPLANET, a web-based decision-support and matchmaking platform that connects farmers with beekeepers using real-time NASA Earth observation data.
Our platform analyzes satellite-derived vegetation indices (NDVI/EVI from MODIS and Landsat) alongside land surface temperature and soil moisture (SMAP) to pinpoint the exact blooming peak of registered farmlands. When a field reaches optimal pollination readiness, BEEPLANET flags it and coordinates the timely dispatch of local bee colonies.
his solution is vital because scientifically timed pollination increases yields by up to 70–80% in pollinator-dependent fruit trees, allowing farmers to maximize productivity within narrowing harvest windows while protecting biodiversity and supporting sustainable, adaptive agriculture.
details:
1. The Problem: Field Shift and Shrinking Seasons
Shifting planting calendars, soil degradation, and changing weather patterns are transforming traditional agricultural cycles worldwide. As growing seasons shorten, farmers face severe drops in crop yield and quality, directly threatening global food security.

2. How It Works & System Architecture
Rather than trying to halt environmental shifts overnight, BEEPLANET mitigates their negative impacts by maximizing efficiency within the narrowing harvest window. Our web-based decision-support and matchmaking platform connects farmers with beekeepers in four streamlined steps:

  • User Onboarding: Farmers register their agricultural parcels (location, crop type, area), while beekeepers register their active hive capacities.
  • NASA Data Acquisition: The system retrieves real-time and historical Earth observation parameters for the registered field coordinates.
  • Suitability Analysis: The platform analyzes vegetation density and thermal conditions to detect the critical blooming window (peak curve).
  • Actionable Matchmaking: Farmlands reaching peak pollination readiness are flagged as "Optimal/Ready" on the interface, enabling timely hive deployment.

3. Benefits, Creativity & Intended Impact

  • Creative Approach: Instead of focusing solely on crop rotation or soil treatment, BEEPLANET bridges two vital agricultural sectors—crop farming and apiculture—turning satellite phenology data into an actionable logistics network.
    • SDG 2 (Zero Hunger): Directly boosts agricultural productivity and crop quality despite shrinking growing seasons.
    • SDG 15 (Life on Land): Promotes biodiversity and supports healthy pollinator populations.

4. NASA Data Integration, Tech Stack & Factors Considered
To ensure accurate field suitability and protect bee health, our team considered plant phenology, microclimate thresholds, and bee foraging behavior using open-access NASA datasets:

  • Vegetation Indices (NDVI / EVI via MODIS & Landsat): Monitors plant health, biomass density, and the exact onset of the blooming phase.
  • Land Surface Temperature & Soil Moisture (SMAP & MODIS): Evaluates microclimate conditions suitable for both crop flowering and honeybee foraging activity.
  • Software Development & Data Tools: The web application was built using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with React serving as our JavaScript-based user interface library. We utilized NASA AppEEARS for satellite parameter extraction and deployed the live platform via Firebase Hosting (https://web.app).

5. Testing the Prototype (For Judges)
Judges can explore the live web interface directly without creating a new account using our pre-configured demo credentials:

Quick Test Steps:

  2. Inspect the satellite-derived vegetation/flowering curve on the dashboard.
  3. Switch to the Beekeeper account to view matching "Ready for Pollination" farmlands nearby.

6. Future Roadmap

  • Phase 1 (Current MVP): Farmer/Beekeeper onboarding, NASA satellite data integration, and real-time suitability flagging.
  • Phase 2 (Near-Term): Integrating higher-resolution satellite imagery and Machine Learning models to forecast blooming windows weeks in advance for proactive logistics.
  • Phase 3 (Long-Term): Built-in interactive training modules for farmers and beekeepers on adaptive agriculture, colony health, and sustainable pollination practices.
